main-title: Select the SWF file to run
player-loading: Preparing to run the player... Please wait.
settings-info: Select the desired option and it will be reflected immediately.
settings-info-playing: Your choice is saved at once. Some emulation options, such as the renderer and the quality, apply to the playing file after you press '{{restart}}' on the player.
settings-desc-4: You can choose between light mode and dark mode.
settings-window-desc: Choose how the app starts and how its window opens.
settings-desc-2: Customize the interface displayed on the player.
settings-scale-desc: Choose how the file fits the player when their sizes differ. Some files choose their own mode. Turn on the option below to keep the one chosen here.
settings-letterbox-desc: Covers the area outside the file's stage with black bars, so only the area the creator intended is shown.
settings-desc-5: Customize the player graphics rendering engine. Unless you are an advanced user, we recommend selecting 'Auto'.
settings-desc-6: Adjust the player graphics quality. Lower values are faster but result in lower graphic sharpness. Higher values may degrade performance. 8x8 and 16x16 smooth edges further where the graphics card supports it, but the webgl renderer draws them like High.
settings-desc-8: Text is displayed normally regardless of this setting. Some special text requires the {{e}} setting. Selecting option {{c}} can resolve most issues, but this method is still experimental and may cause rendering problems when applied.
settings-playback-desc: Choose how the file behaves while it plays.
settings-script-limit-desc: A script that runs longer than this is stopped. Raise it if a heavy file stops partway on a slow computer.
settings-desc-7: Sets the player runtime. Leave the default unless you have a special file. The AIR runtime is currently experimental.
settings-acceleration-desc: Draws the app and Flash content with the graphics processor (GPU). Turn it off only if you see graphics problems such as a broken or flickering screen. Playback may be slower without it, and the change takes effect after the app restarts.
settings-debug-log-desc: Shows the log Ruffle writes beside the game while a file on this computer plays, to help find out why a file does not work. Each level also records the ones before it, and a change applies the next time a file starts.
restart-required: You must restart the app for the changes to take effect!
settings-other-desc: Choose advanced settings for app behavior.
settings-reset-desc: Returns the app data to its initial value. Your saved settings and data will be permanently erased!
